title: Provenance
description: How the fact was produced. REQUIRED on every event in every domain. `observed_at` is the canonical location for observation time: where publication time differs materially from occurrence time after a store-and-forward outage, the envelope `time` stays at the occurrence time and `observed_at` records when the producer saw it. `confidence` is REQUIRED on any event produced by inference rather than direct measurement; events declaring `inferred: true` in the catalog constrain it as required at their own reference site.

producer.description: Producing software and semantic version, e.g. "mca-ingest/2.11.3".

node.description: Identifier of the site or core node that produced the event.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, millisecond precision. When the producer observed the fact.

confidence.description: Inference confidence in [0,1]. REQUIRED for inferred events. Consumers MUST NOT treat an inferred event as a measured one. Not rounded to fixed precision: a lossy round-trip is worse than a long decimal.
